packagesIndex.title: All packages
packagesIndex.lead: A crawlable index of every published package in the registry. Search by name, owner, description, tag, or category, and narrow results with filters.

home.popularHeading: Most downloaded in the last year
home.emptyCatalog: No packages are available in the catalog yet.
home.heroHeading: Ready-to-use agents and flows for Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
home.heroLead: Agents Repo is an open, curated registry. Find maintained packages, install them with the CLI, or try instructions in a browser chat—without rewriting prompts for every tool.

supportedTools.heading: Works with your AI coding tools

value.heading: What you gain
value.discoverBody: Search agents and flows by name, owner, tags, and tool. Status badges show what is maintained.
value.installBody: The CLI places packages into GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex layouts.
value.chatBody: Copy instruction URLs and prompts into ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, or Microsoft Copilot when a package is chat-ready.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: Find an agent or flow on Home or Packages, then open the package page for details.
howItWorks.step2Body: Run two CLI commands in your project, or copy chat-ready instructions into a browser chat.
howItWorks.step3Title: Use it in your coding tool
howItWorks.step3Body: The agent or flow is ready in GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex.

cliQuickstart.heading: Install with the CLI
cliQuickstart.lead: Initialize your project, then install a package. For real projects, pin the CLI as a devDependency so teammates and CI use the same version.
cliQuickstart.copyFailure: Could not copy to clipboard. Copy the command manually.

useInChat.heading: Use in chat without installing
useInChat.body: Some packages are chat-ready. Copy an instruction URL or markdown and a starter prompt into ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, or Microsoft Copilot in the browser—no project install required.

contribute.heading: Help grow the catalog
contribute.body: The project needs agents and flows packages most. Submit a maintained package, or see other ways to help.
